references.text: The same requirement for thorough investigation and confirmation of the truth before judgment in cases of idolatry
Judges must examine the case carefully to uncover the truth
Uses similar Hebrew words to investigate and scrutinize a case thoroughly
Parallel procedure for handling idolatry in society with a requirement for thorough investigation
Describes idolatry as an 'abomination' (תּוֹעֵבָה) - the same term is used
The tribes of Israel investigate a wicked act committed among them
Job investigated cases thoroughly for those he did not know, similar to a righteous process
